trickyParts: The live editor's step must run after remarkDispatchMarksPlugin: before it, a block-level <span data-dispatch> is raw html and a valid ask would fail the fit check and be drawn as text. The valid mark-span ask row is the ordering lock.
unfitTypedBlocksRemarkPlugin reads schemaCtx at transform time: Milkdown builds the remark processor before the schema.
The stored closing ':::' is unescaped: with the opening line escaped no container is open, and a lone ':::' paragraph reads back as text (escape_test.go's ':::' row).
deviations: The engines-alike unit row also ignores a heading's id attribute: the live editor fills it from the heading text after a load, the headless engine leaves it empty.
The plan expected the stored closing fence escaped; Go's renderer stores it plain, which round-trips as text.
openQuestions: Out of scope per the spec: an ask a Yjs collaborative merge leaves holding another block is dropped by y-prosemirror (packages/envoy/internal/dispatch/docs/ask_blocks.go:592-596). Named to the architect.
